dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Japan Medical Association open-source receipt system), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL
evidence: MCP-STATUS / MCP-EVENT / MCP-FUNC / MCP-PUTTYPE patterns typical of ORCA framework

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) processing system - error message screen component for the XA (re-print) subsystem
purpose.summary: This is an error-screen handler subprogram (ORCGXAERR) within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software. It evaluates MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT to either initialize or navigate back to the previous screen, calling ORCDBMAIN to perform a PUTWINDOW operation. It acts as a screen navigation/error display component in the ORCA GUI framework.

notable_features: High comment ratio (57%) with Japanese-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded Shift-JIS/EUC-JP)
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple COPY books for screen areas (XA01, XA99, XAERR, XAID1, XAID2)
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT pattern (ORCA framework event dispatch)
11 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary ORCA MCP framework
verdict.notes: Japanese comments are encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake. File is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The program is a small screen-navigation subprogram with minimal logic, typical of the ORCA component architecture.
